description: Standard Gitflow (feature, release, hotfix) without leaving VS Code: start, finish and push, local merge or Pull Request (GitHub, Azure DevOps), version tags. English and French.
config.dotnetPath: Path of the `dotnet` executable used to run GitFlow. Empty (default): the .NET 8 runtime is provided by the **.NET Install Tool** extension.
welcome.noRepository:
No Git repository in the open folder.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
welcome.notInitialized:
GitFlow is not initialized in this repository: it creates the develop branch and the standard git-flow configuration.
[Initialize GitFlow](command:gitflow.init)
welcome.error:
GitFlow could not start. See the log for details.
[Show Log](command:gitflow.showOutput)
[Restart Server](command:gitflow.restartServer)
